entry_thesis: US-Israel strikes on Iran launched Feb 28 are triggering a structural oil supply shock as Iranian forces threaten Strait of Hormuz closure—through which ~20mb/d flows. Brent crude surged from ~$73 to $100+ trajectory, making the energy sector (XLE) the only major sector in the green YTD and the clearest beneficiary. With the Fed holding rates at 3.5-3.75% and signaling just one cut in 2026 due to Iran-driven inflation risk, higher-for-longer rates further support energy cash flows while the oil shock sustains sector outperformance.
risk: A rapid diplomatic de-escalation or ceasefire could reverse the oil spike quickly, as much of the XLE premium reflects the Hormuz risk premium.
catalyst: Continued Strait of Hormuz disruption and IEA March Oil Market Report (mid-March) confirming supply shortfall will accelerate energy sector inflows.
